description: Balisage maritime (aides à la navigation) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.shom.fr. "Aids ton navigation" product contains a description of landmarks, beaconage or buoyage, present in the French Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) at the date of this edition. June 12 2023 version. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Aids to navigation (AtoN)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include balise, amer, landmark, phare, Open data, Product. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2023-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
